title: Computer use
description: Allow this AI session to operate the signed-in desktop on the session host: open apps, switch windows, click and type. Activity and screenshots appear in chat.
scope: The AI can operate every app on this computer; turn this on only for tasks you trust. Several sessions can have it on at once, but their actions may interfere; stopping a reply pauses it and your next message resumes.
windowsOnly: Supports signed-in Windows x64 and macOS 13+ desktops
unavailable: Cannot read status. Check the host connection and daemon version.
waitForTurn: Stop the current reply before enabling computer use.
completed: Request returned; verify the result in the app
permissionsHint: On macOS, allow "Cua Driver" both permissions below in System Settings. Cua Driver is the desktop driver that ships with Yi Console; the grants stay after Yi Console upgrades.
permissionsRetry: This updates by itself once you allow them. If Screen Recording still shows as not allowed, turn computer use off and on again.
driverMissing: This Mac has no desktop driver. Computer use needs the Yi Console desktop app installed on this Mac; a daemon deployed over SSH has none.
driverError: The desktop driver is not responding: {{message}}
